items.stem: A large area of forest near a town is cleared and covered with buildings and roads. Predict how this would affect the local water cycle and carbon cycle.

items.markingKey: (a) A consumer is an organism that cannot make its own food and depends on other organisms for food.

items.stem: In the food chain leaves → caterpillar → sparrow → cat, what would happen if all the caterpillars were removed?
items.answer: The leaves would grow unchecked (less eaten), and the sparrow population would fall for lack of food; the balance of the whole chain would be disturbed.
items.markingKey: 1 mark: effect on level below. 1 mark: effect on level above. 1 mark: imbalance.

items.stem: Which of the following is a step in which vapour changes into water or falls back?
items.answer: formation of clouds
items.markingKey: (b) Formation of clouds is a step in which vapour changes into water or falls back. The others: drying of wet clothes – a step in which water changes into vapour; evaporation from the sea – a step in which water changes into vapour; transpiration from leaves – a step in which water changes into vapour.

items.stem: What would happen if there were no decomposers?
items.answer: Dead bodies and wastes would pile up and nutrients would not return to the soil, so plants would not get them.
items.markingKey: 1 mark: wastes pile up. 1 mark: no recycling.

items.stem: In the food chain leaves → caterpillar → sparrow → cat, the leaves store 20 000 J of energy. If only about 10% of energy passes to each next level, how much energy reaches the cat?

Assertion (A): Mushrooms are producers.
Reason (R): Mushrooms are fungi that absorb nutrients from dead matter.
Choose the correct option.
items.answer: A is false, but R is true.
items.markingKey: (d) A false; R true.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
A is true, but R is false.
A is false, but R is true.
